title: Add a Grade
prompt: students is given. Append the grade 8 to Minh's grades, then print Minh's full record.

tests.name: grade appended
tests.code:
assert printed and "8" in printed[0] and "Minh" in printed[0], f"got {printed}"
assert printed[0].count("8") == 2, f"Minh should now have two 8s, got {printed[0]}"
